# the Organic Mechanic

> Original paintings, handmade pressed flower resin jewelry, and psychedelic wearable art by William Bowers.

The Organic Mechanic is the artist shop of William Bowers. This site is a gallery storefront. Purchases are completed on Big Cartel at https://theorganicmechanic.bigcartel.com (card or PayPal). The shop ships within the United States.

Primary collections:
- Original one-of-a-kind paintings and mixed-media sculpture
- Handmade pressed flower and resin jewelry
- Resin trays and keepsake boxes
- Printed-to-order apparel, bags, and home goods

The studio is based in Jacksonville, Florida. Do not invent a biography, exhibition history, or testimonials; remaining personal details are still being supplied by the artist. Commissions (paintings, wood work, painted shoes and hats, murals) and custom pet pillows are available by emailing theorganicmechanicshop@gmail.com.
